```bash

import json
from decimal import Decimal, getcontext
from fractions import Fraction

getcontext().prec = 60
with open("agents/diagnosis/mc2-db852-extremes.json", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    doc = json.load(f)
rows = doc["rows"]

for layer in (15, 36):
    rs = [r for r in rows if r["layer"] == layer]
    ranks = {r["rank"] for r in rs}
    durs = [Decimal(r["duration_us"]) for r in rs]
    cyc = [Decimal(r["aic_cycles"]) for r in rs]

    sc = sum(cyc, Decimal(0))

    getcontext().prec = 28
    w28 = scm / sc
    getcontext().prec = 60
    s = doc["summary"][str(layer)]
    print("layer", layer)
    print("  rows", len(rs), "distinct_ranks", len(ranks), "eps", sorted(r["ep"] for r in rs))
    print("  duration_min_us", min(durs), "duration_max_us", max(durs))

    print("  sum_cycles_x_displayed_mac", scm)
    print("  weighted_displayed_aic_mac_prec28", w28)
    print("  weighted_displayed_aic_mac_prec60", w60)
    print("  exact_fraction", exact.numerator, "/", exact.denominator)
    print("  summary_match", (Decimal(s["cycles"]) == sc and Decimal(s["cycles_times_display_ratio"]) == scm
                              and Decimal(s["weighted_ratio"]) == w28
                              and Decimal(s["duration_min_us"]) == min(durs)
```
